headline: Gland Pharma reports 58 percent jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Strong CDMO growth drives profit higher
summary: Gland Pharma reported a 58.2 percent year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹291 crore. Revenue grew 23.3 percent to ₹1,834 crore, driven by a 31 percent increase in CDMO revenue and an 18 percent rise in Critical Injectables. EBITDA surged 54.1 percent to ₹484 crore, with margins expanding to 26.4 percent. Indian retail investors holding pharmaceutical stocks can assess execution strength in contract manufacturing.
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly earnings boost investor sentiment for Gland Pharma shares

headline: Gland Pharma secures US FDA approval for injectable steroid
hook: New US FDA approval for Gland Pharma
summary: Gland Pharma has received US FDA approval for its Methylprednisolone Acetate Injectable Suspension. The product is indicated for the treatment of various inflammatory and allergic conditions. This approval allows the company to market both single-dose and multiple-dose vials in the US market. The drug is a generic version of a reference product, expanding the company's portfolio of injectable offerings.
why_it_matters: New product launch potential boosts revenue prospects for Gland Pharma.

headline: US FDA issues four observations to Gland Pharma's Hyderabad plant
hook: Regulatory scrutiny at Gland Pharma facility
